title: Software Engineer (Shared Components)
teaser: We are currently hiring a Software Engineer to drive hands-on development for a core foundational architecture component supporting over 90% of Webex Platform services. You will design, implement, and maintain shared Java libraries, contributing to agile product delivery. Ideal candidates have strong software development experience and a background in analytical subjects.
description:
Meet the Team

Cisco's Webex Engineering Group is redefining the future of collaboration. We're building a world where people connect effortlessly to enjoy modern, uncompromised collaboration across every room, desk, pocket, and application.

Our technology powers industry-leading products like Webex Meetings, Webex Calling, and Webex Contact Center. As a member of our team, your work will ensure every user gets a truly immersive experience regardless of device or location, empowering the hybrid working patterns of the future. 

We are looking for a highly skilled Software Engineer to drive hands-on development for  a core foundational architecture component implemented as a shared java library that powers over 90% of services across the Webex Platform.

Our team is based in Galway. We operate a hybrid working model. 

Your Impact

·       Full Lifecycle Development: being part of an agile team to design, develop, test, and deliver new features and improvements to our products.

·       DevOps & Microservices: Help lead the operational side of our highly available microservice architecture.

·       Shared Components: design, implement, test, and maintain core features in the shared java library. Specifically develop highly reliable shared components for HTTP clients, service infrastructure, data access, messaging, metrics, logging, secrets, rate limiting, health checks, and build tooling.

·       Embrace AI technology: Leveraging these transformative technologies to accelerate the team’s productivity and the delivery of customer features.

·       Adaptable & Problem-Solver: Tackle varied and challenging problems daily, showing flexibility, a data-driven focus on quality, and an ability to learn new skills quickly.

·       Ownership & Quality: Take responsibility for tasks, from building new functionality to developing automated tests and investigating issues, all with a level of high attention to detail.

·       Support & Growth: Receive dedicated mentorship and formal training from a supportive team of fellow engineers to help you get up to speed and grow your skills.

Minimum Qualifications

·       3rd Level Qualification: Bachelor's or higher degree in an analytical subject (e.g. Computer Science, Electronic/Software Engineering).

·       Work experience: Demonstrated 3+ years experience in software development.

·       Coding Aptitude: Extensive architecture and programming experience and the willingness to learn new technologies quickly.

·       Problem Solver: Ability to apply and lead a scientific approach and creative skills to complex problems.

·       Adaptable & Collaborative: Flexible, thrives in diverse team environments, and communicates clearly and precisely.

·       Quality Focus: Strong attention to detail and a commitment to continuous learning and quality results.

 

Preferred Qualifications

Knowledge of programming in one or more of the following languages: Java, Python, C++, JavaScript

Experience owning internal platform libraries or frameworks used by hundreds or thousands of services.

Experience modernizing legacy Java components while preserving compatibility.

Experience with observability tools such as Splunk, Prometheus, Micrometer, InfluxDB, Grafana, or similar systems.

Experience with security scanning, SBOM generation, dependency vulnerability management, and static analysis.

Hands-on use of Codex or similar AI coding agents in real software development workflows. 

We provide training and mentoring for all new team members to fill in any gaps.
